20261122-physics-e2-1.title: Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino
20261122-physics-e2-1.topic: Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino
20261122-physics-e2-1.goal: Apply principles of Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e2-1.material: [Hanoin avansada] Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino vakuu vidru neʼebé ár hotu hasai, no halo alarme tuur. Relójiu nia ponteiru hakfodak no taka sino, maibé la rona son. Tansá?
20261122-physics-e2-1.thinking.0: Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Hanoin avansada] Ema tau relójiu alarme iha sino vakuu vidru neʼebé ár hotu hasai, no halo alarme tuur. Relójiu nia ponteiru hakfodak no taka sino, maibé la rona son. Tansá?
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.explain: Son lori liuhusi vibrasaun husi substánsia hanesan ár (meiu), nune'e iha vakuu ne'ebé la iha ár, son la lori.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Atu son to'o ita nia tilun, presiza buat ida hanesan ár atu lori.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Iha vakuu la iha molekula gás.

20261122-physics-e2-2.title: Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone
20261122-physics-e2-2.topic: Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone
20261122-physics-e2-2.goal: Apply principles of Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e2-2.material: Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone nian, komparasaun saida mak loos kona-ba son nia aas ka kiik husi tekla naruk no badak?
20261122-physics-e2-2.thinking.0: Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Bainhira toka xilofone ka tekla xilofone nian, komparasaun saida mak loos kona-ba son nia aas ka kiik husi tekla naruk no badak?
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Tekla badak liu, objetu nia vibrasaun iha segundu ida (frekuénsia) barak liu no son aas, no tekla naruk liu, frekuénsia kiik liu no son kiik.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Objetu badak no manipis liu, vibra lalais liu iha segundu ida.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Frekuénsia barak liu, son aas liu.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Tekla badak liu, hakfodak lalais liu, no son aas liu
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Tekla naruk liu, son aas liu
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Tekla nia naruk la iha relasaun ho son aas ka kiik
